items.title: Frank Capp interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: I did twelve years on The Red Skelton Show

ctx.x: I know of him. I never met him.

He was a great arranger. Great arranger and great piano player too. And I did a lot of work with him. Do you know I can’t remember, I mean there’s so many. I mean you name ‘em, I probably worked with them. Benny Carter, Ray Brown. I did twelve years on The Red Skelton Show when, fellows who remember variety television, I did that with David Rose.
